total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of pre-IPO equity rounds per Wikipedia (citing press/TechCrunch sources): $3.2M seed (2013) + $37.2M Series A (2014) + $83M Series B (2015) + $50M additional round (2020) = $173.4M; excludes debt financing facilities ($50M in 2014, $130M credit line in 2016) and post-IPO public market financing (e.g. a March 2026 stock offering upsized to $800M).
total_funding_usd.quote: The company's seed funding was led by IA Ventures and raised US$3.2 million in July 2013. Its series A round of funding in March 2014, led by venture capitalist firm Andreessen Horowitz, raised US$37.2 million. ... In July 2015, the company raised US$83 million in its series B round of funding led by Access Industries with participation from Andreessen Horowitz. ... In May 2020, DigitalOcean raised an additional $50 million from Access Industries and Andreessen Horowitz.

last_round.quote: In March 2026, DigitalOcean upsized stock offering to $800 million to fund its AI and infrastructure growth.

revenue.basis: DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc. FY2025 10-K (full company revenue, not broken out by product; GPU Droplets is one product line within this).

note: DigitalOcean is a public company (NYSE: DOCN, IPO March 2021). GPU Droplets is a product line, not a separately financed entity; figures above are for the whole company since product-level financials are not disclosed.
